hollow:rattling-deep.title: The Rattling Deep
hollow:rattling-deep.summary: A Hollow that broke open inside a goblin warren off the [[place:long-road|Long Road]]. The goblins did not run from the fire. They put it to work.

sections.title: How it opened
sections.text: When the Underflame broke into the warren, the [[beast:goblins|goblins]] living there learned to forge with it within a season. Dwarf patrols on the Long Road started meeting goblins with hot iron instead of stolen knives, and the holds asked the Pact for help.

sections.title: The three wings
sections.text: The Snare Tunnels are the warren's outer ring, strung with traps. The Scrap Market is where the goblins trade what they steal, ruled by [[beast:tinker-queen|the Tinker Queen]]. The Throne of Rust at the bottom belongs to [[beast:old-rustjaw|Old Rustjaw]], who was a goblin once.

facts: Under the [[place:greyteeth|Greyteeth]], off the Long Road
Snagtooth, the Tinker Queen, Old Rustjaw

beast:snagtooth.title: Snagtooth
beast:snagtooth.summary: The warren's watchdog: a huge tunnel rat the fire got into, wearing a collar of stolen dwarf rings.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: The goblins say they raised Snagtooth from a pup. The dwarves say nobody raises a thing like that; it just keeps eating. Both agree it bites through armour.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It goes for the tank's arms and leaves a rusty wound that keeps bleeding. Healers learn to watch the whole group, not just the front.

beast:tinker-queen.title: The Tinker Queen
beast:tinker-queen.summary: The cleverest goblin in the Rattling Deep, who builds bombs out of the Underflame and sells them to anyone who pays in metal.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Nobody knows her real name. She was the first goblin to put a spark of the Underflame in a jar, and the rest of the warren has been afraid of her since.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: She throws bombs at everyone and sends spark bombs rolling at the back line. Kill the bombs before they reach the healer.

beast:old-rustjaw.title: Old Rustjaw
beast:old-rustjaw.summary: A goblin king who sat too close to the Underflame for too long, and grew into a giant of scrap and rust.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Rustjaw crowned himself king of the warren the year the Hollow opened, and built his throne on top of the crack. Each year he is bigger and less goblin.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: He uses everything the warren knows: crushing blows on the tank, bomb barrages, blasting charges and more spark bombs at half health.

hollow:ashen-grove.title: The Ashen Grove
hollow:ashen-grove.summary: A Hollow in what is left of an Elderwood glade the [[era:great-burn|Great Burn]] reached. The trees are grey, the ash is warm, and [[beast:shadow-beasts|shadow-beasts]] hunt in the smoke.

sections.title: How it opened
sections.text: The glade burned in the Great Burn and never cooled. Years later the elves of the forest edge found out why: the Underflame had broken through under the roots, and the smoke that came up was full of hungry shapes.

sections.title: The three wings
sections.text: The Grey Glade is where the [[beast:charred-stag|Charred Stag]] still walks its old paths. The Smoke Ring is the nest of [[beast:smoke-mother|Smoke Mother]]. In the Heart of the Burn waits [[beast:long-shadow|the Long Shadow]].

facts: the Charred Stag, Smoke Mother, the Long Shadow

beast:charred-stag.title: The Charred Stag
beast:charred-stag.summary: The great stag of the glade, burned black and still standing, still guarding the forest that is gone.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Elven songs remember a white stag that led lost travellers out of the Elderwood. The Charred Stag walks the same paths. It no longer leads anyone out.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It rakes the tank with burning antlers and shakes ash storms out of the trees over the whole group.

beast:smoke-mother.title: Smoke Mother
beast:smoke-mother.summary: A shadow-beast grown so large it is more weather than animal, and the mother of every wisp in the grove.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Where the smoke is thickest the shadow-beasts gather, and where they gather long enough, they become one thing. The elves call it Smoke Mother and do not go near.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: She chokes one hero at a time and seeds the ground with embers that grow into fire. Healers have to cleanse fast and the damage has to kill the seeds.

beast:long-shadow.title: The Long Shadow
beast:long-shadow.summary: The shadow at the bottom of the burn: tall as the old trees, and as old as the fire under them.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Some elves say it is the shadow of the Elderwood itself, left behind when the trees burned. Others say it was here before the forest, waiting under the roots.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It uses everything the grove has: smothering blows, ash storms, a wave of dusk that throws heroes back, choking smoke and ember seeds.

hollow:frostgate-pass.title: Frostgate Pass
hollow:frostgate-pass.summary: The high pass where the [[beast:trolls|trolls]] come down every winter. This winter a Hollow opened under the gate, the trolls took the watchtowers, and they did not leave.

sections.title: How it opened
sections.text: The pass guards have fought trolls at Frostgate for as long as there has been a pass. When the ice under the gate began to steam, the trolls stopped going home in spring. Something warm under the snow was feeding them.

sections.title: The three wings
sections.text: The Lower Switchbacks belong to [[beast:grumm|Grumm the Gatebreaker]]. [[beast:mother-hrimm|Old Mother Hrimm]] holds the Fallen Watchtower. At the Gate of Ice sits [[beast:winter-king|the Winter King]].

facts: Grumm the Gatebreaker, Old Mother Hrimm, the Winter King

beast:grumm.title: Grumm the Gatebreaker
beast:grumm.summary: The troll who broke Frostgate's outer gate with a tree trunk, and has carried the trunk ever since.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Grumm is not clever even for a troll, but he is very large and very patient. He sat outside the gate for nine days before he decided to knock.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: He swings his club at the tank hard enough to crack shields, and stamps the ground until the whole group stumbles.

beast:mother-hrimm.title: Old Mother Hrimm
beast:mother-hrimm.summary: The oldest troll in the mountains, a frost-witch who calls hail and makes ice grow out of the floor.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: The pass guards' grandmothers told stories about Mother Hrimm. Nobody believed them until she sat down in the watchtower and started singing.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: She calls hail on the group, freezes one hero at a time and grows ice spikes that must be broken quickly.

beast:winter-king.title: The Winter King
beast:winter-king.summary: A troll the Underflame has warmed into something enormous, crowned in ice that never melts.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Trolls have no kings. This one decided otherwise. Every troll that comes down from the snows now kneels at the Gate of Ice before it goes raiding.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: He uses everything the pass has: avalanche blows, hail, quakes that throw heroes down, frostbite and ice spikes.

hollow:sunken-caravan.title: The Sunken Caravan
hollow:sunken-caravan.summary: A [[race:felkin|felkin]] spice caravan that the [[place:endless-dunes|dunes]] swallowed whole. The [[beast:sand-wyrm|sand-wyrms]] nest in its wagons now, and something still guards the cargo.

sections.title: How it opened
sections.text: Forty wagons left [[place:saffra|Saffra]] and never reached the springs. Years later the sand slid away from the first wagon roof, and the heat that came out of it was not the sun's.

sections.title: The three wings
sections.text: The Buried Wagons are guarded by [[beast:glass-scorpion|the Glass Scorpion]]. In the Spice Vault, [[beast:caravan-master|Caravan Master Ossek]] still counts his cargo. The Wyrm Nest belongs to [[beast:dune-wyrm|the Dune Wyrm]].

facts: the Glass Scorpion, Caravan Master Ossek, the Dune Wyrm

beast:glass-scorpion.title: The Glass Scorpion
beast:glass-scorpion.summary: A desert scorpion the Underflame turned to living glass, as big as a wagon and as sharp as broken windows.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Lightning makes glass in the dunes. So, it turns out, does the Underflame, and once it made a scorpion.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It stings the tank, poisons the group's damage dealers and blasts sand over everyone.

beast:caravan-master.title: Caravan Master Ossek
beast:caravan-master.summary: The felkin who led the lost caravan, still guarding its cargo long after he should have died.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Ossek swore to the Saffra spice guild that his caravan would arrive. It never did, and he never stopped keeping the promise.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: He cracks his whip to knock heroes back, blasts sand and hatches wyrm eggs from the cargo.

beast:dune-wyrm.title: The Dune Wyrm
beast:dune-wyrm.summary: The sand-wyrm that ate the caravan: the largest ever seen, and still growing on the Underflame's heat.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Felkin guides say the wyrms always gathered under that stretch of the dunes. Now they know why.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It uses everything the caravan holds: tail slams, sandblasts, strikes from below, venom and hatching eggs.

hollow:wyvern-roost.title: The Wyvern Roost
hollow:wyvern-roost.summary: The cliffs of [[place:kaldera|Kaldera]], where the old dragon nests stood empty until the [[beast:wyvern|wyverns]] moved in. The [[race:draka|draka]] want them gone.

sections.title: How it opened
sections.text: The draka never let anyone near the old nests. When the Underflame broke through under them and the wyverns came to feed on the heat, the draka were too few to stop them, and for the first time they asked the Pact for help.

sections.title: The three wings
sections.text: On the Cliff Path waits [[beast:old-scar|Old Scar]]. The Bone Ledges are held by [[beast:brood-mother|the Brood Mother]]. In the Old Nest sleeps [[beast:kaldrax|Kaldrax the Ashen]].

facts: Old Scar, the Brood Mother, Kaldrax the Ashen

beast:old-scar.title: Old Scar
beast:old-scar.summary: A one-eyed wyvern bull who has fought every draka hunter for thirty years and kept every scar.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: The draka of Kaldera have a saying for something that will not die: as stubborn as Old Scar.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It tears at the tank, breathes fire over everyone and beats the air hard enough to throw heroes off their feet.

beast:brood-mother.title: The Brood Mother
beast:brood-mother.summary: The wyvern queen who lays her cinder eggs in the Underflame's heat, so that every hatchling comes out burning.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Wyverns lay a few eggs a year. Near the Underflame the Brood Mother lays dozens.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: She bites, breathes fire, poisons one hero at a time and lays cinder eggs that hatch if nobody breaks them.

beast:kaldrax.title: Kaldrax the Ashen
beast:kaldrax.summary: The largest wyvern alive, grey with ash, sleeping in the nest of a dragon. Some draka whisper that he wants to become one.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Wyverns are the stupid cousins of dragons. Kaldrax is not stupid. He chose the oldest nest, the one over the hottest crack, and he has not left it in years.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: He uses everything the roost has: rending bites, fire breath, wingbeats, searing venom and cinder eggs.

hollow:starfall-observatory.title: The Starfall Observatory
hollow:starfall-observatory.summary: A star tower of the [[faction:conclave|Conclave]] that a falling star split open. The [[faction:ashen-choir|Ashen Choir]] moved in to sing to the Hollow underneath, and the stars sing back.

sections.title: How it opened
sections.text: The Conclave built the tower to watch the stars shift in the [[era:waking|Waking]]. One night a star came down instead, straight through the dome, and the Underflame came up through the crack it left. The mages fled. Within a month the Choir was holding services on the broken stair.

sections.title: The three wings
sections.text: The Broken Stair is guarded by [[beast:sellune|Archivist Sellune]], who stayed behind. The Orrery Hall belongs to [[beast:orrery-engine|the Orrery Engine]], still turning. At the Lens of Heaven, [[beast:cantor-vey|Cantor Vey]] leads the hymn.

facts: A hill a day's ride from the white towers of the Conclave
Archivist Sellune, the Orrery Engine, Cantor Vey

beast:sellune.title: Archivist Sellune
beast:sellune.summary: The tower's archivist, an elf mage who would not leave her books when the star fell. She listened to the Choir instead.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Sellune spent three hundred years cataloguing what the stars said. When the Choir told her the stars were saying something new, she believed them, because she had heard it too.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: She hits the tank with a gilded tome heavy enough to dent plate, whispers the Choir's words into one mind at a time and calls small stars down on the group.

beast:orrery-engine.title: The Orrery Engine
beast:orrery-engine.summary: A brass model of the heavens as big as a house, built to follow the stars. It still follows them, and now they lead it.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Dwarf smiths built it for the Conclave over forty years. The star that fell knocked it off its tracks, and since then its rings turn on their own, faster every season.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: Its rings sweep the floor and pull the group off its feet, and every few turns it drops a fallen star into the fight. Kill the stars quickly.

beast:cantor-vey.title: Cantor Vey
beast:cantor-vey.summary: The highest singer of the [[faction:ashen-choir|Ashen Choir]] anyone has met and lived to tell. Vey stands in the lens of the tower and sings the Hollow wider.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Nobody knows what Vey was before the Choir. Vey says it does not matter, because the Underflame will make everyone the same in the end.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: Vey uses everything the tower has: starsteel strikes, starfall, gravity wells, the Choir's whisper and falling stars. The song gets louder as the fight goes on.

hollow:drowned-undercroft.title: The Drowned Undercroft
hollow:drowned-undercroft.summary: The smugglers' vaults under Freeport harbour, flooded when a Hollow opened beneath the sea wall. The [[faction:syndics|Syndics]] want their cargo back and do not ask what is guarding it.

sections.title: How it opened
sections.text: Officially the vaults held grain. When the sea wall cracked and the tide came in hot, the Syndics hired the Pact quietly, paid in advance and did not answer questions. The things that came out of the water did not need to be asked.

sections.title: The three wings
sections.text: The Bonded Warehouse is still run by [[beast:harbourmaster-quell|Harbourmaster Quell]]. The Flooded Vaults are the hall of [[beast:barnacle-knight|the Barnacle Knight]]. At the Tide Gate waits [[beast:mother-brine|Mother Brine]].

facts: Harbourmaster Quell, the Barnacle Knight, Mother Brine

beast:harbourmaster-quell.title: Harbourmaster Quell
beast:harbourmaster-quell.summary: The Syndics' harbourmaster, who kept the books of every cargo that was not on the books. He went down to save the ledgers and stayed.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Quell knew every crate in the undercroft by smell. When the water came in he would not leave without his ledgers, and the Hollow gave him time to find them all. It has been two years. He is still counting.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: He swings his iron hook at the tank, knocks the group around with crates and rots one hero at a time with salt water.

beast:barnacle-knight.title: The Barnacle Knight
beast:barnacle-knight.summary: A knight of the old Crown who drowned in the vaults a hundred years ago, wearing armour the sea has been building on ever since.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Nobody knows why a knight of [[faction:crown|the Crown]] was in a smugglers' vault. The Syndics say he was a thief. The Crown says he was chasing one. He has not said.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: He cuts the tank with a coral blade, floods the vault in waves and calls tide crabs out of the walls.

beast:mother-brine.title: Mother Brine
beast:mother-brine.summary: A sea serpent the size of a ship who came up through the cracked sea wall and coiled around the tide gate. She is why the harbour runs warm.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Old sailors tell of a serpent that followed the felkin spice ships south for a thousand years. They thought she had died. She had found somewhere warmer.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: She uses everything the undercroft has: anchor-heavy blows, floodwater, riptides, brine rot and swarms of crabs. Do not stand still when the tide turns.

hollow:cold-forge.title: The Cold Forge
hollow:cold-forge.summary: The halls under the Heartforge of [[place:kaldera|Kaldera]], where the [[race:draka|draka]] fire has burned since the [[era:dawnfire|Dawnfire]]. It is cooling, because something down there is drinking it.

sections.title: How it opened
sections.text: The [[faction:fire-council|Fire Council]] argued for a year about why the Heartforge was cooling. Then the flame-speakers who went down to look stopped coming back, and the Council asked the Pact for help a second time. Nobody enjoyed it.

sections.title: The three wings
sections.text: The Bellows are held by [[beast:varrak|Flame-Speaker Varrak]]. In the Slag Rivers walks [[beast:slag-colossus|the Slag Colossus]]. In the Heart Gone Cold waits [[beast:rimeheart|Rimeheart]], the thing that drinks the fire.

facts: Flame-Speaker Varrak, the Slag Colossus, Rimeheart

beast:varrak.title: Flame-Speaker Varrak
beast:varrak.summary: The draka flame-speaker who went down first to find out why the forge was cooling. He found out, and decided to keep it fed himself.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Varrak spoke for his flight at the Fire Council for sixty years. He swore he would keep the Heartforge lit, and he is still trying, with whatever he can throw into it.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: He brings his forge hammer down on the tank, sprays slag over the group and drains the heat out of one hero at a time.

beast:slag-colossus.title: The Slag Colossus
beast:slag-colossus.summary: A giant of cooling slag that rose out of the forge's waste rivers. It is trying to stay warm.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: The draka poured the forge's slag into the rivers for a thousand years. When the forge started cooling, the slag got up and walked toward the last of the heat.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It pounds the tank with molten fists, blasts the group back with heat and sheds dying embers that must be put out before they burst.

beast:rimeheart.title: Rimeheart
beast:rimeheart.summary: A shape of frost and hunger curled around the Heartforge's core. It eats fire. It has been eating this one for years.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: The draka say there is no such thing as a cold Hollow. Rimeheart is one anyway: a crack where the Underflame runs the wrong way, and something waiting at the end of it.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It uses everything the forge has: hammer blows, slag spray, bellows blasts, heat drain and dying embers. Its frozen grasp gets colder as the forge dies around it.

hollow:dreaming-deep.title: The Dreaming Deep
hollow:dreaming-deep.summary: The bottom of the [[place:long-road|Long Road]], below the last dwarf hold, where the [[world:underflame|Underflame]] comes from. Something sleeps down there, and it is starting to dream.

sections.title: How it opened
sections.text: It did not open. It was always there. The dwarves dug the Long Road toward it for six hundred years and sealed the last door when they understood what they had found. In the [[era:waking|Waking]] the door broke from the other side.

sections.title: The four wings
sections.text: The Last Hold is still guarded by [[beast:hollowhand|Thane Hollowhand]]. Through the Root of the World coils [[beast:root-wyrm|the Root Wyrm]]. In the Waking Halls sings [[beast:nightmare-choir|the Nightmare Choir]]. And in the Dragon's Dream sleeps [[beast:ysolvane|Ysolvane]], who does not wake, but fights anyway.

facts: The bottom of the [[place:long-road|Long Road]], under the [[place:greyteeth|Greyteeth]]
Thane Hollowhand, the Root Wyrm, the Nightmare Choir, Ysolvane

beast:hollowhand.title: Thane Hollowhand
beast:hollowhand.summary: The dwarf thane who sealed the last door of the Long Road six hundred years ago, and swore to guard it until the end of the world. He took that literally.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: His name was Durin Brask before the door. He gave his hand to the seal, and the rune-priests say the hand is still in it. The rest of him stayed on watch, and is not entirely alive any more.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: He hits the tank with a runed axe, shakes the hall with the old seal's power and lays dwarven curses on anyone he thinks does not belong.

beast:root-wyrm.title: The Root Wyrm
beast:root-wyrm.kicker: Coiled in the Root of the World
beast:root-wyrm.summary: A wyrm of living fire as long as a river, coiled through the cracks at the root of the world. It is not the sleeper. It is what the sleeper breathes out.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: The draka have a word for it that means 'the first breath'. They say every Hollow in [[world:valdren|Valdren]] is a place where the Root Wyrm once turned in its coils.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It crushes the tank in burning coils, rains dreamfire on the whole group and breaks dream shards off the walls as it moves.

beast:nightmare-choir.title: The Nightmare Choir
beast:nightmare-choir.summary: Every hero, cultist and miner the Deep ever took, singing together in the sleeper's dream. Some of them are still trying to warn you.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: The [[faction:ashen-choir|Ashen Choir]] believes it sings to the Underflame. The Nightmare Choir is what it sounds like from the other side.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: It sings dreamfire down on everyone, puts nightmares into one hero at a time, knocks the group back with discord and fills the hall with dream shards.

beast:ysolvane.title: Ysolvane, the Dreaming Dragon
beast:ysolvane.summary: One of the dragons of the [[era:dawnfire|Dawnfire]], asleep since the [[era:sundering|Sundering]]. She is not awake. What you fight is her dream of you.

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: The old songs say the dragons fell asleep when the Underflame broke through, and that the world will end the day they wake. Ysolvane is turning over. Every band that beats her dream buys the world a little more sleep.

sections.title: In battle
sections.text: She uses everything the Deep has: sleeper's claws, dreamfire, the world turning over beneath the group, nightmares and dream shards. She never truly dies. She just sleeps more deeply, until next week.
